opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 (Adelphi co‑sponsored award); up to £300 (virtual conferences)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members (undergraduate, MSc and PhD students; postdocs within six years of PhD viva) for Scheme A, and to PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva for Schemes B & C. Applicants must present a poster or talk and have a supervisor who is a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, or virtual conferences) by covering travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (students can apply as soon as they become members; others need at least one year of membership).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics‑related training courses or undertake collaborative visits to learn specific techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK). Applicants must provide a supervisor’s supporting letter.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research projects that aim to produce results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.
